children: Poland's current account deficit amounted to 2.42 billion euros  ($2.79 billion) in July, compared to a deficit of 2.22 billion euros in the previous month, central bank data showed on Monday.
Economists polled by Reuters had expected a deficit of 2.34 billion euros in July.
